description:
"Call on Azura to send a twilight matriarch to fight at your side. The twilight matriarch's zap deals |cffffff1211|r Shock Damage and its kick deals |cffffff1211|r Shock Damage.

Once summoned, you can activate the twilight matriarch's special ability for |cffffff4728|r Magicka, causing it to heal |cffffff2|r friendly targets for |cffffff11321|r and itself for |cffffff5660|r.

The twilight matriarch remains until killed or unsummoned."
